decisions.rationale: Not a race. us.state is a jurisdiction attribute, not an identity key: many organisations legitimately share us.state=OK, so this scheme is not guarded (ADR-110). The pair exists because the P21.4 seed (ops/src/ops/seed.py, okc_agency_rows) deliberately projects two near-duplicate organisations for the ER match step. They are sig.connector.subject agency:okc:okcpd-1 'Oklahoma City Police Department' and agency:okc:okcpd-2 'Oklahoma City Police Dept'. Each gets the same us.state identifier, in one sequential pass 0.33 s apart. On the identity question the pair poses, they are one agency: the same municipal police department of Oklahoma City, with the same organization_type, the same state, and names that differ only by the abbreviation Dept/Department. So the decision is same_as.
